summary.text: David Lowe is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 91 who has served since January 14, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Yisak Worku is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: David Lowe was born in Dallas, Texas, served in the U.S. Army from 2003 to 2015, and earned a bachelor's degree from American Military University in 2018.
His career experience includes working as a stay-at-home father, police officer and corrections officer.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Lowe said he was the North Regional Director for the Republican Party of Texas in 2020 and had graduated from the Texas Peace Officers Academy.
Lowe assumed office in the Texas House on January 14, 2025, succeeding Stephanie Klick.
In the 2024 survey, he listed his priorities as border security, election integrity, a property tax overhaul and term limits.
